summary: 10/10 validation dimensions passed. 0 data leakages across 12 temporal causality checks.

scorecard.supporting_evidence: 100 match-level block bootstrap resamples generated stable empirical distributions. Mean CI width: ~14.5 pts batting, ~6.1 pts bowling.
scorecard.operational_impact: Quantified statistical uncertainty without delivery-independence artifacts.

scorecard.supporting_evidence: Top-10 bootstrap overlap: 6/10 (Batting), 6/10 (Bowling). LOMO max single-match drop <= 3 ranks.
scorecard.operational_impact: Rankings are robust against match perturbations; no one-match wonders dominate.

scorecard.supporting_evidence: Rank correlation across 6 alternative weighting profiles averages rho > 0.92 (Batting) and rho > 0.89 (Bowling). Jaccard overlap >= 0.70 across all profiles.
scorecard.operational_impact: Conclusions do not depend on arbitrary scoring weight choices.

scorecard.supporting_evidence: Varying exposure thresholds (+/-50%) retains >=80% of top 10 members. Tighter thresholds eliminate low-sample candidates cleanly without disrupting established anchors.
scorecard.operational_impact: Phase 8 eligibility boundary (40 balls / 48 legal balls) sits at the optimal stability plateau.

scorecard.supporting_evidence: Top performers (Rinku Singh, Wade, Little, Chase) maintain top tier status across high-RRR, high-wicket, and extreme-cutoff pressure definitions.
scorecard.operational_impact: Validates that detected clutch execution is genuine match situation mastery, not an artifact of Phase 4 weightings.

scorecard.supporting_evidence: Top 10 contains balanced representation across both IPL and T20Is: 0 IPL / 5 T20I (Batting), 0 IPL / 8 T20I (Bowling).
scorecard.operational_impact: Tournament volume differences do not bias ratings against international or league performers.

scorecard.supporting_evidence: Batting top 10 represents Top Order, Middle Order, and Finishers. Bowling top 10 includes Powerplay, Middle, Death, Pace (5), and Spin (5).
scorecard.operational_impact: Tactical responsibilities do not incur artificial penalties.

scorecard.supporting_evidence: Empirical Bayes shrinkage successfully shrinks small-sample raw scores towards cohort priors. Volume correlation is moderate and non-dominant (r=0.565 batting, r=0.269 bowling). CI width decreases with sample size.
Contextual (phase/competition) baselines yield rho=0.707 rank correlation and 9/10 top-10 overlap with overall baselines.
scorecard.operational_impact: Baseline methodology is consistent and resilient to contextual baseline adjustments.

scorecard.supporting_evidence: All 12 checks passed: 0 critical sequence violations, 0 future delivery leaks, 0 match result dependencies, 0 negative runs, and strict bowler wicket attribution rules.
scorecard.operational_impact: Methodology is statistically defensible and free from future data contamination.

leakage_audit.evidence: Found 0 pre-delivery temporal sequence violations out of 100k+ deliveries.
Found 0 instances of first innings deliveries flagged as chasing.

leakage_audit.test_performed: Match Result Independence in Player Ratings
leakage_audit.evidence: FBPR and FBOR are strictly computed from ball-by-ball execution and baseline retention. Match winning outcome is 0% weighted.
Baselines are constructed from 2022+ historical distributions without future predictive lookahead.
Found 0 deliveries with uncalculated pre-delivery pressure scores.

leakage_audit.test_performed: DLS and Revised Target Bound Validation
leakage_audit.evidence: Found 0 implausible DLS revised targets in match metadata.
Found 0 duplicate delivery keys in reconstructed match state.
Found 0 deliveries with missing striker_id or bowler_id.
Verified across Phase 7 and Phase 8 that run outs, retired hurts, and obstructing field dismissals are strictly excluded from bowler wicket tallies.
Found 0 wides or no-balls erroneously marked as legal deliveries.
Found 0 negative run values across deliveries.
